text: Self-serve API keys are generated in User Settings → API Access, and API keys and webhooks are included on all plans
quote: API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.

text: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated in the Fathom website settings
quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.

text: API lists recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team
quote: List the 10 most recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team.

text: External API lets you poll meetings, teams, and team members

text: API endpoint lists teams, and meetings can be filtered by team name
quote: summary: List teams operationId: listTeams

text: Meetings can be filtered by the domains of their associated companies
quote: Returns meetings whose associated company matches one of the specified domains.

text: Meetings can be filtered by meeting type using names returned from the API
quote: Use the returned `name` values as the meeting_type filter on GET /meetings.

text: API can fetch the call summary for a specific meeting recording
quote: Get summary ... Either the destination URL for where we'll POST the call summary, or the summary for the recording.

text: Summary endpoints either return data directly or POST it asynchronously to a destination_url you provide
quote: If you send `destination_url`, the endpoint will behave in an asynchronous manner. If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.

text: Endpoint starts async generation of a downloadable recording file and returns a download_id to poll
quote: Starts async generation of a downloadable file and returns a `download_id` to poll.

text: Completed downloads provide a short-lived signed URL for the generated file
quote: When the download is completed, the payload carries a short-lived signed URL for the generated file.

text: Admin-only API endpoint lists all users in the account with their permissions
quote: List all users in the account with their permissions. Admin only.

text: Admins can be granted view access to all shared calls, so their API key can read everything shared across teams
quote: grant one or more Admins view access to all shared calls; that Admin’s key can then read everything shared across teams.

text: meeting_url is included in API responses and webhook payloads
quote: Added `meeting_url` to API response and webhooks.

text: Webhooks send meeting data to your URL, optionally including summary, transcript, and action items
quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.

text: Webhook creation lets you include transcript, CRM matches, summary, and/or action items in the payload
quote: Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.

text: Webhooks can be created and deleted through API calls
quote: You also have the option of creating and deleting webhooks with an API call.

text: Webhooks can be added from the UI under Manage > Add Webhook
quote: Generate an API key, then go to Manage > Add Webhook

text: Webhook requests carry a signature header so you can verify the payload is authentic
quote: Each webhook request sent from Fathom includes a signature in the request headers, which you can use to confirm the authenticity of the payload.

text: SDKs provide a verifyWebhook helper to validate incoming webhook requests
quote: If you're using our SDK, you can use the verify_webhook helper. Simply call: Fathom.verifyWebhook(webhook_secret, request.headers, request.body)

text: Official TypeScript and Python SDKs handle authentication, pagination, and error handling
quote: Get started in minutes with our official SDKs. They handle authentication, pagination, error handling, and all the complex stuff so you can focus on building amazing integrations.

text: Official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, honoring the Retry-After header
quote: The official SDKs automatically retry rate-limited requests, waiting for the duration indicated by the `Retry-After` header.

text: Python SDK can be used in a shell via uv and the uvx command
quote: You can use this SDK in a Python shell with uv and the `uvx` command

text: Both SDKs support OAuth 2.0 for integrations installable by multiple Fathom accounts
quote: Both TypeScript and Python SDKs support OAuth 2.0 authentication for building integrations that can be installed by multiple Fathom accounts.

text: Developers can build public OAuth apps that other Fathom users can install
quote: Build a Fathom integration that other users can install.

text: OAuth apps are eligible for App Marketplace visibility and co-marketing by Fathom
quote: OAuth apps are eligible for promotion by Fathom and can unlock visibility in our App Marketplace, as well as co-marketing opportunities.

text: Official MCP server connects Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude
quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.

text: Any MCP-compatible tool can connect using the server URL, then authenticate to access meeting data

text: Fathom is available as an official connector in Claude
quote: Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude

text: The Fathom MCP server can be added to Claude Code from the command line
